newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kinugawa, Calsonic plan takeover of Teito Rubber.
newsitem.headline: Kinugawa, Calsonic plan takeover of Teito Rubber.

text.p: Kinugawa Rubber Industrial Co Ltd and Calsonic Corp said on Wednesday that they would conduct a joint takeover bid for Teito Rubber Ltd.

They will seek to acquire a majority of Teito's shares from December 26, 1996 to January 15, 1997. The move is aimed at restructuring Teito Rubber's management, they said, adding that they planned to buy 1.2 million shares at 300 yen per share.
Teito Rubber, a rubber hose manufacturer, announced at the same time that its executives agreed to the takeover in order to strengthen ties with Kinugawa and Calsonic.
After completing the move, Kinugawa Rubber would hold about 33.44 percent of Teito Rubber's shares and Calsonic would have about 16.90 percent, the companies said.
